scope: Static review of the frozen protocol, input identities, acquisition, runtime preparation, strict validation, lexical ranking, five-arm fusion, synthetic metric gate and failure-stop boundaries before new data acquisition or effectiveness.

contract_checks.input_identity: Frozen input-plan identity, exact byte sizes, four SHA256 bodies and one Git-blob SHA1 body; both identity forms independently recomputed before parsing.
contract_checks.resource_and_stop: One fresh ignored acquisition directory, no reuse/retry/mirror substitution, aggregate 1200-second hard timer and per-read checks; five fixed raw inputs remain below 1.05GB, wheel/archive separately capped. Partial failures retained.
contract_checks.runtime_support: Pinned wheel identity and platform checks, bounded safe extraction, immutable evaluator revision route and pinned metric source hash, make command and binary receipt; no global installation or retrieval.
contract_checks.cohort: Validate the entire binary qrel domain before exclusions; complete cache coverage includes zero-IDCG test queries. Positive-IDCG cohort is ascending string IDs; no source intersection or retrieval-success eligibility. Query-text source may contain additional non-test rows.
contract_checks.text_and_identity: Strict cache/Parquet schemas, string IDs, duplicate and mismatch rejection, exact title-newline-body and pinned corpus/query text agreement. Query and document namespaces remain separate.
contract_checks.statistics: Unchanged build_collection_stats sees unique P-candidate documents across only the frozen retained cohort. SPLADE-only, excluded-query-only and unretrieved qrel documents do not enter the statistics pool.
contract_checks.lexical_order: Four unchanged fixed scorers, full P candidate scoring before top200 cap, captured unrounded scores and original stable descending order; exact ties retain P array order. Tokenized-empty queries stop.
contract_checks.fusion: P and S retain supplied order/depth up to1000; A has four lexical lists, B adds S, H has P plus S. Canonical k60 uses one-based ranks, unit weights, fsum and ascending string-ID computed-score ties.
contract_checks.metrics_and_diagnostics: All five equal-query binary nDCG means and B-A/B-S/B-P/A-P/B-H contrasts use complete qrels IDCG and preserve unjudged positions. A/B truncated binary RBP uses p=4/5 without mass normalization. Actual top10 denominators and candidate/judgedness diagnostics are retained; no p-values or confidence intervals.
contract_checks.authoritative_gate: Eleven fixed synthetic queries cover ranks1/2/10/11, multiple and unretrieved positives, IDCG cutoff, absent versus explicit-zero qrels, short/empty lists, tied original scores and identical query/document strings. Strict decreasing rank-proxy export, binary domain, named numeric tolerances and complete output keys are required.
contract_checks.code_and_failure_identity: A required passed preflight rechecks source hashes before scoring. Immutable execution/effectiveness start records precede metrics; all numeric rankings are persisted first and each completed query outcome is flushed. Failure receipts distinguish whether effectiveness began or completed. No automatic recovery run is implemented.

findings.initial_issue: The initial driver computed metrics before persisting rankings and lacked phase/effectiveness flags, so an error during metrics could lose first-run outcomes without identifying a post-effectiveness failure.
findings.resolution: Landed before acquisition: numeric rankings precede analyze; effectiveness-start.json, streamed per-query.jsonl, phase and started/completed flags preserve the boundary. The focused synthetic second-query fault test exercises retention of first-query outcomes and all rankings.
findings.evidence_limit: Source and targeted test reviewed; no real-run improvement observed.

findings.initial_issue: Runtime precondition failures occurred before the helper's receipt try/finally, leaving only a traceback.
findings.resolution: Landed CLI fallback writes failed_before_runtime_prepare with error type and explicit false SciFact parsing/effectiveness flag when no receipt exists.
findings.evidence_limit: Source reviewed; coordinator reports a successful synthetic missing-support reproduction. No real setup failure observed.

resolved_uncertainty.question: Does pinned trec_eval -q -c emit an empty-result query as well as include it in the aggregate denominator?
resolved_uncertainty.resolution: Metric worker inspected exact pinned trec_eval.c: missing query receives bogus_ranking, then common per-query printing and accumulation. Current parser requirement is supported; no contract correction needed.
resolved_uncertainty.evidence_limit: Primary-source interpretation was supplied by the metric worker; this review did not fetch that source or run the evaluator. The authoritative gate remains required.

review_actions: Read project agreements and relevant frozen/current contracts.
Read implementation and synthetic test sources; compare to the declared contract and local unchanged scorer/fusion functions.
Inspect final phase/preflight/runtime corrections and compute reviewed file SHA256 identities.
Return findings and follow-up review to coordinator and bounded implementation workers.
limits: No new dataset bodies downloaded, parsed or inspected by this reviewer.
No real collection effectiveness, source/model retrieval, provider calls, authoritative evaluator invocation, build or package installation performed by this reviewer.
Synthetic test source review is distinct from independently executing those tests; coordinator and implementers own execution receipts.
Static contract agreement does not establish actual cache schema, complete input identity/text compatibility, successful runtime setup or a passed authoritative metric gate.
Independent reconstruction of actual rankings and outcomes remains future work after the frozen run.
